disorder-name.detail: Major depressive disorder; diagnosed according to DSM-IV criteria by at least two attending doctors; two-site clinical cohort comprising discovery cohort (NBH) and external test set (NDTH)
disorder-name.supporting_text: "all depression patients were diagnosed by at least two attending doctors and assessed by the Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression 17-item (HAMD-17) for depression severity"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Two local hospital sites with no public dataset names: (1) Affiliated Brain Hospital of Nanjing Medical University (NBH) — discovery cohort (127 DP + 110 HC); (2) Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital (NDTH) — external test set (60 DP + 56 HC).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "127 depressed patients and 110 healthy control (HC) participants from the Affiliated Brain Hospital of Nanjing Medical University as the discovery cohort. Additionally, 60 patients and 56 HC participants from Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital were recruited as an external test set."

age.detail: Combined 187 DP patients (discovery cohort DP n=127, mean=30.81±8.77 years; external test set DP n=60, mean=34.57±10.58 years). Weighted mean=(127×30.81+60×34.57)/187=32.02 years; Pooled SD=sqrt((126×8.77²+59×10.58²)/185)=9.39 years. Min/max not reported.
age.supporting_text: "Age, Years: 30.81 ± 8.77 [Discovery Cohort DP, n=127]; 34.57 ± 10.58 [External Test Set DP, n=60]"

sex.detail: Combined 187 DP patients: Discovery cohort DP Female/Male=61/66; External test set DP Female/Male=39/21. Combined: Female=61+39=100 (53.5%), Male=66+21=87 (46.5%). Percentages calculated from counts.
